new_value: {"acceptance_criteria":"DESIGN.md states release files and kup are out of scope with the reason; no doc claims git-vouch signs release files; cover note matches.","description":"DECIDED (Mark 2026-10-23): release-file signing (tarball .tar.sign, sha256sums.asc, the checksum autosigner) and kup upload authentication are out of git-vouch's scope. Reasons: a handful of release signers, not a keyring; endorsements/tiers/continuity do not apply; a release tarball is git archive of a signed tag, which git-vouch covers, so anyone can regenerate and compare; moving distro gpg --verify scripts to ssh-keygen costs downstream a lot for little gain. kernel.org owns tarball signing and kup auth (GPG today). git-vouch replaces the keyring, not every gpg use; gpg remains for a few release keys and old tags. Rejected: (b) SSH signatures alongside GPG during an overlap. To do when the docs lock frees: DESIGN.md states the scope (Summary/Flag day: what git-vouch covers: tags, commits, patches, registry records); remove or narrow any DESIGN mention of ssh-keygen -Y for release files.","title":"Release files and kup are out of scope"}
